chunks: Verily you will die, and so will they.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the death of the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm the humanity of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) and to counter claims of his divinity or immortality, highlighting that even the chosen messenger is subject to the universal law of death. It serves as a profound reminder of the transient nature of worldly life (dunya) and the certainty of the Hereafter, encouraging believers to focus on eternal deeds rather than temporal power.
